title: Chiral magnons for spin-qubit state transfer
summary: We propose a protocol where chiral magnons mediate a state transfer between two distant spin qubits. The protocol is implemented by varying the coupling between the spin qubits and the magnons in time, such that an arbitrary state is transferred from one qubit to the other. The modulation of the coupling is performed such that the two-spin-qubit state is kept as a dark state of the magnon bath, bypassing the associated losses.
